heroDescription: Make traditional thin pancakes with this simple and delicious recipe
toppings: Jam, berries or fruit for serving
step1: Mix the flour and salt in a bowl
step2: Whisk in half the milk until the batter is smooth
step3: Whisk in the remaining milk and the eggs
step4: Let the batter rest for about 10 minutes
step5: Fry thin pancakes in a little butter, one at a time, in a frying pan
step6: Serve with jam, berries or fruit
